name: Taimashi to Mahou Shoujo (4) ~Koisururei to Inari no Tsuma~
original_name: 退魔士と魔法少女(4)～恋する霊と稲荷の妻～
source:
One month ago, exorcist Kaoru Okumoto was hired to investigate
the nature of a major spiritual force in their hometown and he met
Karen who ended up calling him father for some reason.

This time, Kaoru wakes up to find someone latched onto him.
That someone, is what looks to be Karen's mother... Hasuna.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ199305.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一个月前，退魔师奥本薰受命回到故乡，调查一股强大灵力的来源，并遇见了不知为何喊他“爸爸”的卡莲。

这一次，薰醒来时，发现有人紧紧抱着自己。
而那个人，似乎正是卡莲的母亲…莲菜。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ199305.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
